name: 02458 · Newton, MA
findings: ZIP 02458 (Newton) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02458 (Newton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
